title: XDC RPC endpoint health
description: Status of public XDC JSON-RPC endpoints, checked server-side every 5 minutes with eth_blockNumber. History lines (NDJSON) use this same shape without the metadata fields.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema for this document.

version.description: Major version of this document's format. Fields are only added within a version.

generated_at.description: When this data was produced. ISO 8601, UTC.

update_interval_seconds.description: How often this document is regenerated.

stale_after_seconds.description: If generated_at is older than this, treat the data as stale (the feed may have stopped).

license.description: SPDX licence identifier for the data.

note.description: Optional remark about this copy of the data.

live_url.description: For hourly copies: the live URL this was copied from.

check_method.description: The request used for each check.

endpoint_list_source.description: Where the list of endpoints came from (normally XDC Atlas).

thresholds.description: Rules used to decide each status.

timeout_ms.description: A check with no answer within this time counts as down.

degraded_lag_blocks.description: More blocks behind the network than this is degraded.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID: 50 for Mainnet, 51 for the Apothem testnet.

best_block.description: Network head: the highest block number at least two endpoints agree on.

recommended.description: Up to 3 healthy endpoints, best first (least lag, then best 24 h uptime, then lowest latency). Use the first one if you just need a working RPC.

not_checked.description: Listed endpoints not checked in this run: WebSocket (and any other non-HTTPS) endpoints, and any left for a later run when the list is longer than one run can check.

privacy.description: What the provider says about request logging, as listed in XDC Atlas: none, limited, yes or unspecified.

status.description: ok: answered, in sync and fast. degraded: answered but lagging, slow or inconsistent. down: no valid answer.

latency_ms.description: Round-trip time of this check in milliseconds.

error.description: Plain-language reason when status is not ok.

uptime_24h_pct.description: Share of checks in the last 24 hours that got a valid block number, in percent.

avg_latency_24h_ms.description: Average latency of answered checks in the last 24 hours.

checks_24h.description: Number of checks in the last 24 hours.

recommended_by_atlas.description: XDC Atlas pins this endpoint as a recommended option.
